management_remarks: In Q2 FY25, Jio Platforms achieved strong EBITDA expansion of 17.8% year-on-year as tariff hike transmission lifted Average Revenue Per User (ARPU) to Rs 195.1. Reliance Retail improved its operating EBITDA margin through supply-chain automation, private label scaling, and strong omni-channel digital commerce traction. Our balance sheet remains fortified with Rs 2.08 Lakh Crore in cash and marketable securities supporting disciplined capital allocation.
analyst_qa: Addressing analyst concerns on retail revenue growth moderating to single digits, B2B wholesale restructuring and cautious urban discretionary demand created temporary headwinds. O2C ethane and naphtha cracking margins remain challenging and volatile given weak global industrial recovery. Subscriber churn in lower-ARPU 2G cohorts remains uncertain for one more quarter following tariff adjustments, requiring calibrated retention offers.
